name: design-basics
description: The design-basics gene: metric->fix reflexes for the computable fundamentals of visual design (contrast, type floors, overflow, alignment, palette harmony, line-height). The curriculum is procedurally generated and validated by construction — the mutation generator knows the inverse of every defect it injects, so no pair is hand-authored and no teacher inference is spent.

source.note: infinite via --seed/--count; regenerate bigger before each training round — corpus size is the lift lever

dataset.format: mlx chat {messages} JSONL, train/eval split + manifest

training.path: genome/training-trigger/submit with the dataset's train examples (traitKind design-basics, baseModel = the model her lane serves): learned in place on her live engine, no separate trainer
training.gate: the gene examiner: a candidate opens a trial and is kept ONLY on measured lift on unseen tasks with retention intact; a gene with lift <= 0 is retired

evaluation.heldOut: eval.jsonl (same generator, unseen seeds count too)
evaluation.liveProof: benchmarks/project website tier — the launch+see loop; the gene should raise the structural-grade pass rate and reduce appearance-defect turns

growthPath: v2: mutation stacking (2-3 simultaneous defects, graded severity)
v2: WebSight real-page mutations (2M-page corpus, same defect injectors)
v3: AIM pixel-metric feedback (clutter/grid/colorfulness) once the capture->metric harness lands
v3: vision-describer taste feedback (the eyes+media sprint)
provenance: Recipe-as-data per the forge-template doctrine (CLAUDE.md): the pipeline consumes THIS file; artifacts are generated, never hand-authored. When the ForgeRecipe entity layer lands, this JSON is its seed row.
